definitions.explanation: A clip used to hang laundry on a clothesline to dry.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみで{止|と}める。
examples.english: I secure the laundry with clothespins.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}いので{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみを{多|おお}めに{使|つか}った。
examples.english: Since the wind was strong, I used extra clothespins.

examples.japanese: プラスチックの{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみが{壊|こわ}れた。

notes:
FORMATION:
{洗濯|せんたく} (laundry) + ばさみ (clip/pincer, from {挟|はさ}む)

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {洗濯挟|せんたくばさみ} or {洗濯鋏|せんたくばさみ}.

MATERIALS:
・プラスチック{製|せい} - plastic (most common)
・{木製|もくせい} - wooden (traditional)
・ステンレス{製|せい} - stainless steel

COLLOCATIONS:
・{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみで{止|と}める - to secure with clothespins
・{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみで{挟|はさ}む - to clip with clothespins
・{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみを{外|はず}す - to remove clothespins

RELATED ITEMS:
・{物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお} - laundry pole
・{角|かく}ハンガー - drying rack with clips
